leftEvidence.role: The Father who sees in secret
leftEvidence.title: Forgiving others is placed beside the Father’s forgiveness

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Jesus states that forgiving people’s trespasses is followed by the Father’s forgiveness.
points.right: James prohibits partiality and says God chose the poor in the world to be rich in faith and heirs of the Kingdom.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Refusing to forgive is followed by a negative statement about the Father’s forgiveness.
points.right: Neighbor love is called royal law, the whole law’s integrity is stressed, and mercy triumphs over judgment.

payload.posture: Both sources place human treatment of others beside a future divine response.

rightEvidence.title: The poor, Kingdom, neighbor love, and mercy meet judgment

payload.tension: Forgiveness and mercy overlap but remain distinct actions and arguments.
payload.title: Forgiveness, mercy, and reciprocal judgment
